caption: The drawing features a textile or fabric pattern composed primarily of blue, green, and beige (or cream) colors. Dominating the center is a large paisley motif that is outlined in green, filled with beige teardrop shapes, and decorated with smaller floral and leaf-like details in both beige and green. The background consists of a rich blue color filled with small, closely packed dotted or dashed patterns and additional beige and white decorative elements including smaller floral motifs. Surrounding the paisley are symmetrical curved lines and stylized leaf shapes. The lower section of the design includes a horizontal, repeating geometric border with triangular shapes in blue and green, containing beige floral rosette forms and circular dotted detailing. The composition is intricate, with the main objects being paisleys, leaves, flowers, and geometric shapes in distinct, repeating arrangements.
title: Skirt - Border Design
